sentences.en: All that was left of the zebra was its carcass.
sentences.zh: 最后剩下的只有斑马的尸体。

sentences.en: You will never brush against a zebra crossing a zebra crossing.
sentences.zh: 你永远不会在斑马线上碰到真正的斑马。

sentences.en: I have never had my picture taken with a Mexican zebra.
sentences.zh: 我从未和墨西哥的斑马合照过。

senses.zh: 有斑纹的 （Zebra）斑马（文具品牌）；斑马公司（指盈利性和有责任感的公司）
